The common difference of an arithmetic sequence is the same between any two consecutive terms. In this case, the common difference is 5. The second term is found by adding 5 to the first term. The second term equals 7 + 5 = 12. Therefore, the answer is 12.

The current through an ideal resistor is directly proportional to its resistance. Thus, if the resistance is increased by a factor of two, the current will be doubled. If the resistance is decreased by a factor of three, the current will be halved. Therefore, in this case, the current will be four times that of the original value. The current through a resistor is directly proportional to the voltage across it, provided that the resistivity of the material does not change. Thus, if the voltage is doubled, the current will be halved. If the voltage is tripled, the current will be one-third of its original value. In this case, the voltage is doubled, so the current is halved. The ratio of the two values is 1/3. Therefore, the current through a 6-V resistor is 0.33 A. [Source: Physics Classroom]

The density is calculated by dividing the mass by the volume. The formula for density is m/v, where m is the mass and v is the volume. The given values are 18 grams and 6 cubic centimeters. Therefore, the density is 3 grams per cubic centimeter.

The formula for density is Mass divided by Volume, or M/V. In this case, we have 18 grams of material in 6 cubic centimeters. We can use the formula to solve for density. 18/6 = 3 g/cm 2 . The answer is 3 g/cm 2 .

The average speed is calculated by dividing the distance traveled by the time taken. In this case, the distance is 120 meters and the time is 20 seconds. The average speed equals 6 m/s . [See also Speed (physics).]

The formula for calculating average speed is distance divided by time. In this case, the distance covered in the given time is 120 meters. The time taken to cover that distance is 20 seconds. Therefore, the average speed of the car is 6 m/s. [Source: www.mathsisfun.com]
